tree.heading: Inspection.—
tree.text: A member entitled to vote, or an agent or attorney of the member, may inspect the records of the corporation for any proper purpose, at any reasonable time.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 22031136:1212.Oct. 20, 1978, Pub. L. 95–493, § 12, 92 Stat. 1646.
